title: Public Comment
description: Schema for a public comment submitted to a regulatory docket via Regulations.gov.

commentId.description: Unique identifier for the public comment.

docketId.description: Regulatory docket this comment belongs to.

documentId.description: Specific regulatory document being commented on.

submittedDate.description: Date and time the comment was submitted.

postedDate.description: Date and time the comment was posted publicly.

commenterName.description: Name of the person or organization submitting the comment.

comment.description: Full text of the public comment.
